Description.Name: Gridlocked
Description.Details: Thomas "Gridlocked" Wood learned to fight while the Clans tore the Inner Sphere apart. Born on Luthien and trained at Sun Zhang, he rose to Tai-i in the Ryuken-go during Operation BULLDOG. Methodical, disciplined, and willing to take missions most would consider foolhardy, he built a reputation for surviving the impossible. His defining moment came during a desperate retreat from a Smoke Jaguar lance pursuing his allies. With the logistics train under heavy fire, Wood charged his Marauder directly at the vanguard. A static-laced comm recording captured the Jaguar Star Captain demanding his identity. Wood's reply was short and pointed: "My name is unfit for you. I am him. I will be him. Put me in your Remembrance, Jaguar scum." Wood then rammed his Marauder into the enemy Ebon Jaguar, unloading lasers and ER PPCs point-blank into the cockpit. The war left scars, but also an unexpected respect for former enemy's turned friend. The Second Star League alliance with Clan Nova Cat exposed him to a side of Clan culture few ever saw. While unconvinced by their visions, he became fascinated by their spiritual traditions. Now a mercenary, Wood seeks high-risk contracts, believing skill is forged through adversity. He still hopes to earn selection into the reborn Star League Gunslinger Program. Until then, he measures success the same as always: one battlefield, one opponent, and one hard-won victory at a time.
